bottleneck.description: Industrial PC and embedded-board leader (~34-40% share) with high qualification stickiness in long-life industrial deployments.

dependency.key_customers: Factory automation OEMs, medical equipment, transportation, energy, retail kiosks, NVIDIA-certified edge AI partners
dependency.key_suppliers: Intel/AMD CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, memory/storage vendors

editorial.notes: Advantech holds 34-40% of global industrial PC share -- the largest single share in the segment -- and its products are designed-into long-lifecycle industrial systems with multi-year qualification cycles. Switching to Kontron, Beckhoff, Siemens or Asus IPC adds engineering revalidation cost. However, viable substitutes do exist with peer technical capability, so the position is MEDIUM not HIGH.
